automationNotes: Doc step 1: top navigation bar → App Switcher icon → Personalize. Flow verifies **`App Switcher`** (accessible name), **`Personalize`** in the switcher, landing **`+ New Personalize Project`**, then modal **`Create Project`** before submit. **`use` includes `orgDashboard`** (`#!/dashboard`) as a generic prerequisite; doc-named navigation still starts at App Switcher → Personalize. Handlers: `rules/core/actionRules.ts` (Personalize verify + `create-personalize-project` clicks). Stack: **`DEFAULT_STACK`** in `.env`.
